messages:
carmen (PM): Pushed a compact scope pill into the API Keys list in the mock. Need quick UX and accessibility sanity-checks. Mock: https://img.redwood/compact-pill.png

ravi (Design): Looks good for density. Suggest color legend and a hover/expand to show full scopes. If a key has wildcard/admin show a tiny :warning: tag.

lee (Frontend): Hover popover feasible. We'll make the pill keyboard-focusable and open on Enter. Use a small dialog for actions.

anya (Accessibility): Use role="button" and aria-expanded. If popover has actions, treat it as dialog and move focus in. Announce on open: "Scopes for <key name>".

ravi (Design): Copy idea for pill tooltip: "Scopes: read  embeddings · limited-write". For broad scopes show "broad access" with CTA to rotate/revoke.

lee (Frontend): Prefer actions in kebab menu to keep list clean. Rotate should open modal that shows new secret once with a clear copy button and an "I saved this" confirmation. For broad-scope rotates add a required checkbox: "I understand this may break services".

audit-bot: Note: rotate events for keys with admin/wildcard will be flagged for audit (key=xyz123).

anya (Accessibility): Ephemeral secret modal: focus the secret field, announce "New secret generated; copy now". Ensure copy button is keyboard accessible and the final confirmation is reachable.

carmen (PM): Nice. Action items: Ravi update mock with legend & warning state; Lee prototype keyboard popover, kebab, rotate modal; Anya to add checklist for rotate flow. I'll add acceptance criteria. Thanks!
